raw_llm_output: For Well 15/9-F-9A, the NWIS-Sentinel system predicts a HIGH risk of MUD LOSS, with a score of 0.6 (95% CI: [0.3127, 0.8318]). Six out of ten similar offset wells showed patterns where mud loss incidents occurred. Five of these analogs experienced partial losses, requiring LCM application to bring losses to background [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W31_2011-07-25_MUD_LOSS][SNIPPET_SYNTH-W28_2010-07-21_MUD_LOSS][SNIPPET_SYNTH-W12_2011-01-29_MUD_LOSS][SNIPPET_SYNTH-W22_2010-07-03_MUD_LOSS][SNIPPET_SYNTH-W36_2010-08-14_MUD_LOSS]. However, the analogs do disagree, as SYNTH-W04 shows routine drilling with no anomalies encountered [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W04_2010-01-10_NONE]. This situation is currently for monitoring only, and an actionable alert is NOT YET triggered.
